kql:
let _LockoutUser = {{User}};
Event
| where EventID == 4625
| extend PXML = parse_xml(ParameterXml)
| where PXML.Param[5] == _LockoutUser
| project TimeGenerated, EventID, User = PXML.Param[5], Protocol = PXML.Param[12], Client = PXML.Param[13], ClientIP = PXML.Param[19], Process = PXML.Param[18]
